name: CCA 1368 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动 复飞

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CCA 1368, a flight from Shenzhen to Beijing, your weather radar indicates a squall line near VYK, contact Beijing Approach and request parallel offset 10 miles right of track until PEK VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CCA 1368，这是一趟从深圳飞往北京的航班，气象雷达显示 VYK 附近有飑线，联系北京进近，请求向航迹右侧平行偏置 10 英里，直至 PEK VOR。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA 1368, our weather radar indicates a squall line near VYK, request parallel offset 10 miles right of track until PEK VOR.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA 1368，我们的气象雷达显示 VYK 附近有飑线，请求向航迹右侧平行偏置 10 英里，直至 PEK VOR。

cards.audioText: CCA 1368, Beijing Approach, radar contact, negative due prohibited area, turn left heading 230, track out 25 miles.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1368，北京进近，雷达识别，因禁区原因不批准，左转航向 230，沿该航向飞出 25 英里。
cards.referenceText: roger, turn left heading 230, track out 25 miles, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，左转航向 230，沿该航向飞出 25 英里，CCA 1368。

cards.audioText: CCA 1368, when clear of weather, fly direct to AA443.
cards.referenceText: when clear of weather, fly direct to AA443, CCA 1368.

cards.audioText: CCA 1368, turn right, direct to AA443, hold at AA443 as published.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1368，右转直飞 AA443，按公布程序在 AA443 等待。
cards.referenceText: turn right, direct to AA443, hold at AA443 as published, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 AA443，按公布程序在 AA443 等待，CCA 1368。

cards.audioText: CCA 1368, orbit right from present position until advised, Runway 18L is not available now.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1368，从当前位置向右盘旋直至通知，Runway 18L 当前不可用。
cards.referenceText: roger, orbit right from present position until advised, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，从当前位置向右盘旋直至通知，CCA 1368。

cards.audioText: B: After several orbit, you find the fuel on board will approach the required minimum, report it to Beijing Approach and request leave the hold and request priority landing Runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 经过几圈盘旋后，你发现机上燃油将接近所需最低油量，向北京进近报告，请求离开等待并请求跑道 01 优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA 1368, the fuel on board will approach the required minimum, request leave the hold and request priority landing Runway 01.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA 1368，机上燃油将接近所需最低油量，请求离开等待，并请求跑道 01 优先着陆。

cards.audioText: CCA 1368, after this orbit, leave the hold, fly heading 360, direct to LADIX.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1368，本次盘旋后离开等待，飞航向 360，直飞 LADIX。
cards.referenceText: after this orbit, leave the hold, fly heading 360, direct to LADIX, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 本次盘旋后离开等待，飞航向 360，直飞 LADIX，CCA 1368。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over PEK, maintaining 4200 meters, you have received information S, tell Beijing Approach you are ready for approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在 PEK 上空，保持 4200 米，已收到信息 S，告诉北京进近你准备进近。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA 1368, over PEK, maintaining 4200 meters, information S, ready for approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA 1368，过 PEK，保持 4200 米，信息 S，准备进近。

cards.audioText: CCA 1368, Beijing Approach, follow PEK-05 arrival, descend to 2100 meters on QNH 1008, expect ILS approach Runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1368，北京进近，执行 PEK-05 进场，在 QNH 1008 上下降至 2100 米，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 01。
cards.referenceText: follow PEK-05 arrival, descend to 2100 meters QNH 1008, expect ILS approach Runway 01, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 PEK-05 进场，在 QNH 1008 上下降至 2100 米，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 01，CCA 1368。

cards.audioText: CCA 1368, descend and maintain 1500 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 01, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1368，下降并保持 1500 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 01，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: descend and maintain 1500 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 01, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 1500 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 01，CCA 1368。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have intercepted the ILS signals of Runway 01, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已截获跑道 01 的 ILS 信号，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 1368, established ILS approach Runway 01.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 1368，已建立跑道 01 ILS 进近。

cards.audioText: B: During final approach, an aircraft is crossing Runway 01, you executed a missed approach, report it to Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 最后进近中，一架飞机正在穿越跑道 01，你执行复飞，向北京塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 1368, an aircraft is crossing Runway 01, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 1368，一架飞机正在穿越跑道 01，复飞。

cards.audioText: CCA 1368, climb straight ahead until 230 meters, turn right direct to PEK, hold at PEK at 600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1368，直线爬升至 230 米，右转直飞 PEK，在 PEK 以 600 米等待。
cards.referenceText: climb straight ahead until 200 and 30 meters, turn right direct to PEK, hold at PEK at 600 meters, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直线爬升至 200 和 30 米，右转直飞 PEK，在 PEK 以 600 米等待，CCA 1368。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have landed on Runway 01, you find the runway surface is slippery, the braking action is medium, report it to Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已在跑道 01 着陆，发现跑道表面湿滑，刹车效应中等，向北京塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 1368, the runway surface is slippery, the breaking action is medium.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 1368，跑道表面湿滑，刹车效应中等。

cards.audioText: CCA 1368, roger, thanks, vacate Runway 01via rapid exit E2.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 1368，收到，谢谢，经 E2 快速脱离道脱离 Runway 01。
cards.referenceText: vacate Runway 01via rapid exit E two, CCA 1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 E2 快速脱离道脱离 Runway 01，CCA 1368。
